|gr1= Sides

|descr= Pre-defined variable for the civilian [[Side|side]].<br>
When used in a [[format]] statement (<sqf inline>hint format ["%1", civilian]</sqf>), the string returned is {{hl|"CIV"}}.

|s1= [[civilian]]

|r1= [[Side]]

|x1= [[SQS Syntax|SQS]]:
<sqs>? side _unit == civilian : hint "This is a civilian unit!"</sqs>

|x2= [[SQF Syntax|SQF]]:
<sqf>
if (side _unit == civilian) then
{
	hint "This is a civilian unit!";
};
</sqf>

|text= In '''OFP v1.96''', empty vehicles, objects and dead soldiers are on side civilian.

{{Note
|user= KC Grimes
|timestamp= 20180501150300
|text= In '''Arma 3 v1.82''', units where [[setCaptive]] and/or [[setUnconscious]] are set to true are on side civilian, regardless of low rating (Renegade status).
